title: Ata Manobo language
description: Austronesian language spoken in the Philippines
extract: Ata is a Manobo language of northeastern Mindanao of the Philippines. It is spoken in northwest Davao del Norte province, southeast Bukidnon province, Davao de Oro province, and Davao del Sur province.
